rationale: Budget v11 — verification-audit campaign closeout (2026-07-06). v10's floor (218/225) predated the P4 new-detector wave (9 detectors added: frontend-unsafe-chain, duplicate-handler-race, fabrication-mechanism, workflow-gate-integrity, money-txn-hygiene, realtime-emit-signature, stale-lying-test, dead-macro-call, hardcoded-literal-data-prop) — BASELINE.json was never rewritten after that wave, so the diff gate was comparing against a report missing entire categories and failing every PR on 8 phantom 'new' highs (verified: `node scripts/run-detectors.js --diff --ci` returned `new_high_or_critical count:8` before this rewrite). Root-caused: all 8 are confirmed false positives, not real bugs — 7 money-txn-hygiene flags on functions whose writes are in mutually-exclusive control-flow branches (try/catch fallback pairs, if/else splits, switch-statement handlers, router-factory bodies spanning multiple independent HTTP handlers) that the detector's static write-counter can't distinguish from a genuine sequential multi-write needing one shared db.transaction(), plus 1 frontend-unsafe-chain flag on a .filter() callback reading a freshly-constructed object's guaranteed-array field. Each was hand-verified against the real code, not assumed. Fixed in the same campaign: dead-event-listener 93->72 (arena matchmaking notification, whiteboard live-presence/reactions, terrain-dig deformation shape+name, 8 EmergentEventFeed wirings, secret:weaponised, kingdom:takeover, combat:npc-combo-evolved, spouse:reaction, disease:lethal-progression realtime-emit-signature+dead-listener, a fully-built-but-never-mounted WorldMarkers overlay, voice_chat.leave dead macro removed); stale-lying-test 32->14 (13 test files converted from source-regex assertions to real render/fireEvent/dispatchEvent behavioral tests); dead-macro-call, resource-leak, frontend-unsafe-chain (69->25, remaining 25 hand-verified false positives — inline-guarded reads the detector's control-flow analysis can't correlate), duplicate-handler-race, and the CI gate-integrity holes (deploy.yml PR-path, NODE_ENV=test backstops) all closed to 0 real findings in earlier waves this campaign. maxTotal set to 200 (current floor 190 + ~5%, matching v10's floor+buffer convention) — deliberately NOT set generously above 190, since dead-event-listener/frontend-unsafe-chain/stale-lying-test are exactly the categories this campaign spent the most effort clearing and a loose budget would let them silently regrow.
